newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL-Bank of Portugal seen leaving rates steady.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Bank of Portugal seen leaving rates steady.

text.p: Seven of eight analysts polled by Reuters said they expected the Bank of Portugal to leave its key money market rates steady later on Monday.

They said instability on currency markets and uncertainty over whether Germany might raise its rates soon would deter the central bank from lowering rates, but all the analysts said they expected further Portuguese rate cuts in the medium term.
The Bank of Portugal will announce its terms for the new commercial bank cash reserves period, which starts on Tuesday, at 1315 GMT.
The repo rate has stood at 5.70 percent since July 14. The rate for draining funds currently is at 5.40 percent and the emergency lending rate at 7.40 percent.
The results of the poll are as follows:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo rate this week ?
No - 7
Yes - 1
2. If the central bank lowers its repo rate, how much will it
cut ?
20 basis points
3. Will the central bank cut its rate for draining funds this
week?
No - 7
Yes - 1
4. By how much would it cut its draining rate ?
20 basis points
5. Is there room for further rate cuts ?
Yes - 8
Participants who have agreed to be identified are: Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Credit Lyonnais Portugal; Banco Mello de Investimentos; Fincor; Banco Essi; Banco Comercio e Industria.
